What is All-on-X.Eyebrow: A Full Arch, Built in Layers
Body: All-on-X replaces most or all teeth in one or both jaws with a custom bridge that attaches to dental implants. Unlike a denture that rests on your gums, it's designed to stay secure while you talk, laugh, and eat.
The X is the number of implants. Instead of fitting everyone to a four-implant or six-implant formula, Dr. Sayeedi selects the number and position your bone, bite, and smile actually need.
Layers: **Smile:** Your new teeth are designed for bite, speech, lip support, and a natural look.
**Connection:** Precision components link the implants to your new teeth and share biting forces.
**Foundation:** Implants are placed in your jawbone in positions mapped from your 3D scan.
What is All-on-X.External link: American Dental Association overview of dental implants → https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/implants

Compare.H2: All-on-4, All-on-6, or All-on-X: What's the Difference?
Compare.Intro: More implants aren't automatically better, and fewer aren't automatically simpler. The right design depends on your bone, arch shape, bite forces, materials, and how easily you can keep it clean.
Cards: **All-on-4** (4 implants per arch) · Best for: Arches where four well-placed implants give enough support · How it's planned: Angled back implants can make good use of available bone · Key question: Can four implants handle the forces on this arch?

**All-on-X** (Personalized count) · Best for: Anyone who wants a plan built on their anatomy, not a preset number · How it's planned: Count, angles, and positions are chosen after 3D imaging and smile design · Key question: Which design gives you the safest, most maintainable result?

**All-on-6** (6 implants per arch) · Best for: Patients with enough bone to benefit from two extra support points · How it's planned: Extra implants spread support, but need adequate bone and space · Key question: Would two more implants make this plan stronger?
Links: Read our All-on-4 vs. All-on-6 comparison → https://nobledentalcares.com/blog/all-on-four-vs-all-on-six-which-is-a-better-dental-implant

Benefits.Intro: The goal isn't just to fill spaces. It's to fix the everyday moments that brought you here.
Items: **Chew with confidence:** Implant support can feel far steadier than a loose removable denture.
**Teeth that stay put:** Your new teeth are fixed to implants, so nothing comes out at night.
**A smile designed for you:** Shape, shade, smile line, lip support, bite, and speech are planned together.
**An end to patchwork repairs:** Replace a group of failing teeth instead of fixing them one at a time.
**No more adhesive:** Fixed implant teeth don't rely on denture paste to stay in place.
**One coordinated plan:** Imaging, surgery, temporary teeth, final teeth, and maintenance follow one path.
Benefits.Qualifier: Results, comfort, food choices, and treatment time vary by patient. Full function develops through healing, bite adjustments, and ongoing care.

Steps: **01. Listen and examine:** Dr. Sayeedi learns what isn't working and reviews your health history, teeth or denture, gums, bite, and goals.
**02. Scan and design:** 3D imaging maps your bone and anatomy, and implant positions are planned around your future teeth.
**03. Review your plan:** You'll see your recommended implant count, any extractions or grafting, temporary teeth, materials, timeline, and estimated fees.
**04. Place implants:** Implants are placed following your digital plan, with Yomi robotic guidance when clinically appropriate.
**05. Wear temporary teeth:** Qualified patients may receive fixed temporary teeth during the surgical phase. Others use a different temporary option while healing.
**06. Final teeth and care:** After healing, your final teeth are refined for fit, bite, appearance, and easy cleaning. Regular maintenance protects your result.

Same-day teeth.Eyebrow: A Straight Answer on Same-Day Teeth
Same-day teeth.H2: Can You Leave With Teeth the Same Day?
Body: "Same-day teeth" usually means a fixed temporary bridge attached right after your implants are placed. It isn't your final set of teeth, and it doesn't skip healing.

Whether you qualify depends on implant stability, bone quality, the number and position of implants, bite forces, and your health. If those conditions aren't met, protecting your implants while they heal comes first.
Pairs: **Everyone leaves with teeth on surgery day.:** Same-day eligibility is a clinical decision made for your case, not a promise in an ad.
**Same-day teeth are the final teeth.:** Temporary teeth protect and function during healing. Your final teeth are crafted after your gums and implants heal.
**Once the teeth are in, recovery is done.:** A soft-food period and follow-up visits are still an important part of healing.

Candidacy.H2: Who Is a Good Candidate for All-on-X Near Hayward?
Candidacy.Intro: Adults with extensive tooth loss, a failing arch, or an unstable denture may be candidates. Age alone doesn't decide it. Healing, bone, gums, bite, medical history, and your ability to care for the restoration matter more.
Good signs: Most or all teeth in one arch are missing or have a poor long-term outlook
Gum disease and any infection can be brought under control
There's enough bone for the planned design, or supporting treatment is possible
Medical conditions are stable enough for surgery and healing
You're ready for daily cleaning and regular professional maintenance
Closer look: Uncontrolled diabetes or another condition that affects healing
Smoking, vaping, or other tobacco use
Active gum disease or untreated infection
Medications or health history that may affect bone or surgery
Candidacy.Closing: These factors don't always rule out treatment, but they can change the plan, timing, risks, or the best alternative.

Cost, insurance, and financing.H2: How Much Do All-on-X Implants Cost?
Body: There's no honest one-price-fits-all quote for All-on-X. Your total depends on how many arches and implants you need, imaging, extractions, grafting, sedation, temporary teeth, final materials, lab work, and the complexity of your case.

Noble Dental Care accepts many dental insurance plans and offers third-party financing. Implant coverage varies, so once your plan is ready, our team walks you through your benefits, estimated fees, and payment options before you commit.
